description: This Java class manages callback registries for WebSocket clients, allowing registration, unregistration, and retrieval of different types of expectation callbacks within the mock server framework.

classes.name: LocalCallbackRegistry
classes.description: Manages callback registries for WebSocket clients, supporting registration, unregistration, and retrieval of expectation callbacks.

methods.name: setMaxWebSocketExpectations
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of WebSocket expectations.

methods.name: responseCallbackRegistry
methods.description: Returns the registry map for response callbacks, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: forwardCallbackRegistry
methods.description: Returns the registry map for forward callbacks, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: forwardAndResponseCallbackRegistry
methods.description: Returns the registry map for forward and response callbacks, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for a given client ID based on callback type.

methods.name: unregisterCallback
methods.description: Removes all callback entries for a given client ID.

methods.name: responseClientExists
methods.description: Checks if a response callback exists for a client ID.

methods.name: forwardClientExists
methods.description: Checks if a forward callback or forward-and-response callback exists for a client ID.

methods.name: retrieveResponseCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the response callback for a client ID.

methods.name: retrieveForwardCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the forward callback for a client ID, or falls back to forward-and-response callback.

methods.name: retrieveForwardAndResponseCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the forward-and-response callback for a client ID.
